title: Oven Roasted Chinese Pork Jiaozi
description: A funky and adventurous Chinese dish featuring treacle and score-fat, made with whole30-friendly ingredients in a ceramic tagine, formed into crispy jiaozi.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the ground pork, treacle, score-fat, green onions, ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Mix all the ingredients together until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Lay out round wonton wrappers on a clean surface.
Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of each wrapper.
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edges of the wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
Press the edges together to seal the jiaozi.
Place the jiaozi in a ceramic tagine, leaving some space between each one.
Roast the jiaozi in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
